cohort: The study included 72 family members (husband and another family member) of primiparous pregnant women referred to midwifery clinics in Saveh-Iran.
finding: Group counseling significantly reduced perceived stress, anxiety, hidden anxiety, and obvious anxiety scores in the intervention group compared to the control group among family members of primiparous mothers.
cross-section timing: Measurements were taken at the beginning of the third trimester of pregnancy and again at the time of hospitalizing pregnant women for childbirth.
